class.name: HEGoGeoOutput
class.brief_description: A cooked node's output, read and split from code.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Whether the cook produced geometry with points to read.

method.name: get_point_count
method.description: Number of points in the output.

method.name: get_attribute_names
method.description: Names of every attribute of [code]owner[/code], as Houdini reports them. Available without loading anything, so an HDA can be inspected before it is read.

method.name: get_attribute_names_with_prefix
method.description: The attribute names starting with [code]prefix[/code], for handling whatever an HDA chose to add without naming each one in advance.

method.name: has_attribute
method.description: Whether an attribute of that name and owner exists on the output.

method.name: load_attributes
method.description: Reads attributes from Houdini so the queries below can use them. Attributes another output of the same cook already read are served from the cache without a round trip.

method.name: get_attribute
method.description:
The values of a loaded attribute, one entry per point.
Returns an empty array, with a warning, for an attribute that exists but was never loaded; it does not fetch from the main thread.

method.name: select_all
method.description: Every point, as a selection to filter and split further.

method.name: filter_by
method.description: The points whose [code]name[/code] attribute equals [code]value[/code]. Shorthand for [code]select_all().filter_by(...)[/code].

method.name: split_by
method.description: The points grouped by the value of [code]name[/code], as [code]{ value: HEGoGeoSelection }[/code]. Shorthand for [code]select_all().split_by(...)[/code].

constants.constant: Attributes owned by points. The default for every method taking an owner.
Attributes owned by the detail, i.e. one value for the whole geometry.
